Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.

March 10, 2020
  5:00 P.M.
  Council Chambers of City Hall
  340 Palos Verdes Dr. West
  Palos Verdes Estates

  ACTION MINUTES
  OF THE MARCH 10, 2020 SPECIAL CLOSED SESSION
  MEETING OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA

NEXT RESOLUTION NO. R20-05

NEXT ORDINANCE NO. O20-744

CALL TO ORDER

A Special meeting of the Palos Verdes Estates City Council was called to order by Mayor
McGowan at 6:05 P.M. at Council Chambers of City Hall, 340 Palos Verdes Drive West, notice
having been given with affidavit thereto on file.

ROLL CALL

PRESENT:  Mayor McGowan, Mayor Pro Tem Kemps, Councilmembers Davidson,
  Lozzi

ABSENT  Councilmember Kao

ALSO PRESENT:  Acting City Manager Rukavina, City Attorney Hogin

APPROVAL OF AGENDA - Approved

PUBLIC COMMENT ON CLOSED SESSION ITEM(S) - None

  1.  Conference with Legal Counsel – Existing Litigation
  Pursuant to Government Code §54956.9(d)(1)
  Kinney v. City of Palos Verdes Estates
  Los Angeles Superior Court Case No. 18STCP00352

RECONVENE TO OPEN SESSION

The City Council reconvened to open session at 6:33 P.M. All Councilmembers were present with
the exception of Councilmember Kao.

CLOSED SESSION ANNOUNCEMENT

City Attorney Hogin announced that the City Council met in closed session and discussed the
items listed on the posted agenda, and that the Council has taken no reportable actions.

CITY COUNCIL SPECIAL MEETING - MINUTES
March 10, 2020
 Adjournment to March 10, 2020, at 6:30 P.M. in the Council Chambers of City Hall for the
Regular Meeting.

RESPECTFULLY SUBMITTED,

___________________________________
Carol Cowley, Interim City Clerk

  APPROVED:

  ___________________________________
  David A. McGowan, Mayor

  PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA

NEXT RESOLUTION NO. R20-04

NEXT ORDINANCE NO. O20-744

CALL TO ORDER Mayor McGowan called the March 10, 2020, meeting to order at 6:33 pm.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE was led by Mayor McGowan

ROLL CALL

Present:  Mayor McGowan, Mayor Pro Tem Kemps, Councilmembers Davidson, and Lozzi

Absent:  Councilmember Kao

Also Present: Acting City Manager Rukavina, Assistant to the City Manager Bañales, Assistant City
Attorney Cotti, Treasurer Ying, Police Captain Best, Planning Manager Rindge.

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

Moved by Councilmember Davidson, and second by Mayor Pro Tem Kemps, to approve the agenda
as presented. Motion carried by the Councilmembers present (4-0).

MAYOR’S REPORT – MATTERS OF COMMUNITY INTEREST

Police Chief Velez administered the Oaths of Office to Chuck Reed promoting him to the Rank of
Sergeant and to Aaron Belda promoting him to the rank of Corporal. He presented a brief biography
of each officer. Each Officer’s badges were pinned by their family members.

CONSENT AGENDA (ITEMS 1 – 7)

Consent Agenda Item No. 4 was removed for discussion by Councilmember Lozzi.

CITY COUNCIL MINUTES
March 10, 2020
  1
 ACTION: Moved by Councilmember Davidson, and second by Mayor Pro Tem Kemps, to approve
Items 1 through 7 of the Consent Agenda, excluding Item No. 4 which was pulled for discussion. The
motion carried by the Councilmembers present (4-0); with Mayor Pro Tem recusing himself from
Item No. 3.

PUBLIC COMMENTS FOR ITEMS ON CONSENT AGENDA

1.  Draft City Council Action Minutes

  Reviewed and Approved.

2.  Demands of January March 6, 2020

  Reviewed and Approved.

3.  Planning Commission Actions of February 18, 2020

  Received and Filed.

5.  Acceptance of Donations

  Accepted gifts as presented.

6.  Special Event Application by the Artists’ Studios of Palos Verdes Art Center to Hold its
  Annual Artists’ Studios Tour on Saturday and Sunday March 20-21, 2020

  Approved the Special Events Application.

7.  Special Event Application for Palos Verdes Community Art Association Affiliates
  Summer Art Shows: April 25-26, May 16-17, June 20-21, July 18-19, August 15-16,
  September 19-20, 2020 From 10:00 A.M. to 5:00 P.M. on the Malaga Cove Plaza
  Green

  Approved the Special Events application.

ITEM PULLED FROM CONSENT AGENDA

3.  Approval of Resolutions R20-05, R20-06, and R20-07 Setting Forth Policies and
  Procedures with Reference to the Compensation and Benefits for Management-
  Administration, Sworn Police Management, and Professional and Supervisory
  Personnel

  ACTION: Moved by Councilmember Lozzi, and second by Mayor Pro Tem Kemps, to
  adopt Resolutions R20-05, R20-06, and R20-07. The Motion Carried by the
  Councilmembers present (4-0)

CITY COUNCIL MINUTES
March 10, 2020
  2
 COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC

The following individuals addressed the City Council:
Karen Logan
Desiree Myers
Len Lyberger

CEREMONIAL MATTERS

None.

ORDINANCE/PUBLIC HEARING(S)

8.  PUBLIC HEARING - Introduction of First Reading of Ordinance No. O20-744 Repealing
  Section 17.08.170 (Dwelling Unit, Second) of Chapter 17.08 (Definitions) of Title 17
  (Zoning Procedures), Amending Chapter 18-04 (R-1 Zone) and 18.08 (R-M Zone) of Title
  18 (Zoning Regulations), and Adding Chapter 18.45 (Accessory Dwelling Units) in the
  Palos Verdes Estates Municipal Code.

  The Mayor opened the public hearing. Janine Nendick addressed the City Council.

  There being no one further wishing to address the matter and after Council discussion, the
  Public Hearing was continued to a future meeting.

OLD BUSINESS

9.  Discussion of Pension & Police Operational Review Ad Hoc Committees Activities

  The City Council received and filed the updates from the Council Ad Hoc Committees.

NEW BUSINESS

10.  Palos Verdes Estates’ Efforts to Address Coyote Issues

  The following individuals addressed the City Council:
  John Harbison
  Mark Hamburg
  Ben Goldman

  The City Council received and filed the report provided by the Police Department.

STAFF REPORTS
  i.  Acting City Manager Rukavina shared information garnered from his research on
  retaining a grant consultant.

CITY COUNCIL MINUTES
March 10, 2020
  3
   a.  State of the Police Department – Oral Report

  Captain Best reported on the current status of the Police Department’s recruitment process
  for the various vacant positions.

MAYOR & CITY COUNCILMEMBERS' REPORTS

Councilmember Lozzi requested a discussion regarding a staff assessment/reorganization plan, and
Committees be added to a future agenda.

Mayor Pro Tem Kemps also requested a discussion regarding staff assessment/reorganization plan.

Mayor Davidson requested the following items be added to a future agenda for discussion:
  • List of available grants
  • The possibility of hiring a grants writer
  • Certificates of Participation
  • A discussion regarding giving the Police Chief and City Manager the authority to direct the
  operations of the Police Department be part of the budget discussions
  • Formation of a Historical Preservation Committee
  • Discussion regarding a liaison with the Golf Club

Mayor McGowan requested a discussion regarding Certificates of Participation.

There being no further business to come before the Council, the meeting was adjourned at 9:26 pm
to the Regular Meeting of March 24, 2020, at 6:30 pm at City Hall.

RESPECTFULLY SUBMITTED,

Carol Cowley, Interim City Clerk

  David A. McGowan, Mayor
